messages:
Anya: Proposal: run a short pilot focused on clear IC rotation + handoff timeline templates. Problem: we lose ownership during 2nd/3rd shift handoffs.
Sam: +1. we should force an explicit handoff checklist with 3 checkpoints: 0h (handoff note), 6h (status + owner confirm), 24h (postmortem draft).
Jordan: Agree. Also propose that remediation owners are assigned separately from ICs and that the IC tags the remediation owner before incident closes.
Lee: Suggest timeline template (compact):
- incident_start_ts
- initial_ic
- handoff_slot_ts
- next_ic
- postmortem_publish_target (72h)
- remediation_claim_deadline (72h from publish)
Priya: For comms cadence: 1) rollcall at start 2) three status posts (T+1h, T+6h, T+24h) and one final closure note. Keep them structured: summary, impact, owners, next_steps.
Anya: I like that. Make status posts use a fixed header to make automation easy (e.g., "[STATUS][INC123] summary | impact | owners | blockers").
Sam: automation idea: incident-bot parses those headers and updates a lightweight timeline doc and pings the next IC at handoff_slot_ts. Low lift.
Jordan: Policy idea: IC rotation frequency: max 8 hours per shift during long incidents. After 2 rotations, escalate to oncall lead for continuity.
Lee: Also add a short "handoff ack" requirement: next IC must post "ack @prev_ic" within 10 minutes or bot escalates.
Priya: For postmortem followups, set remediation_claim_deadline = postmortem_publish_ts + 72h. If unclaimed, bot auto-assigns to oncall lead and creates an action with recurrence_flag=false by default.
Anya: Pilot owners? Sam for bot hooks + parsing, Jordan for timeline template + dashboard, Priya for comms cadence docs. I'll own the policy and run retrospective. Start date: 2026-05-04, length 3 weeks.
Sam: I'll prototype the parser that looks for "[STATUS][INC" headers and maps fields to timeline.
Jordan: I'll produce a template JSON schema and example timeline and share by Wed.
Lee: small UX ask: make handoff posts copyable to calendar invites so next IC can accept quickly.
Priya: I'll draft the structured status post examples and share in #eng-oncall.
incident-bot: Reminder: unclaimed remediation items older than 7 days will be flagged to oncall-leads.
Anya: ok team, let's keep the pilot tight. Goal: zero ownership drift during rotations and 72h remediation assignment compliance. We'll review metrics: unclaimed_rate, handoff_ack_latency, and median_postmortem_publish_time.
Sam: ack. posting follow-ups (parser PR + bot config) tomorrow.
Jordan: will share template by Wed.
Priya: drafting cadence doc today.
Anya: thanks all. We'll reconvene at the pilot retro on 2026-05-25.
Lee: :thumbsup:
Sam: :rocket:
Priya: :white_check_mark:
